label: Skool Members Scraper
title: Skool Members Scraper: Map Location & Country Filter
metaDescription: Export Skool community members with their exact map location and country, bio, emails, LinkedIn and socials. Filter members by country before you pay.
intro: Export the members of a Skool community you belong to, straight from its member map: each member's exact location and country, plus name, bio, emails written in the bio, LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, website, role, level, points and last activity. Keep only the countries you need; members outside them are never fetched or charged.
useCases: Plan meetups and events in the cities where members live
Build country-specific prospect lists with LinkedIn and website links
Schedule calls in your members' time zones

faq.q: Why map location instead of the profile location?
faq.a: Most members leave the profile location empty; in a real test community 18% had typed one, while 99.9% had a country from the pin they placed on the member map.

faq.q: Do I need to log in?
faq.a: Yes. Skool shows the member map only to members, so you paste your own Skool login cookie and can export only communities you belong to.
